chunks.title: Microwave Warranty
chunks.content_brief: All PEL Microwaves come with a 2-Year Magnetron Warranty and 1-year spare parts warranty.

chunks.model: PMO-20 W/B M CLASSIC, PMO-20 BH CLASSIC PLUS, PMO-23 SLM SILVER LINE, PMO-23 SLD SILVER LINE
chunks.title: Solo Series (Manual & Digital)
chunks.content_brief: Solo models provide basic microwave functionality. Manual models use dials, while the SLD Silver Line features a digital touch panel.

chunks.model: PMO-23/26/30 DESIRE, PMO-23/26 CHEF, PMO-30 BG GLAMOUR
chunks.title: Digital Grill Models
chunks.content_brief: The Desire, Chef, and Glamour series feature digital touch panels and an added Grill function for crispy food tops. The Chef Digital series (23L/26L) is a premium tier with automated cooking programs and a dark mirror finish.

chunks.model: PMO-25/30 CONVECTION, PMO-23/28 KITCHEN PRO GR, PMO-26 KITCHEN PRO CAF, PMO-30 KITCHEN PRO ICAF
chunks.title: Convection & Kitchen Pro Air Fryer Models
chunks.content_brief: Convection models (25L/30L) add baking capabilities using a Triple Technology design that combines microwave emission, a direct-glow grill ring (1000W), and forced-air convection (1950W) in one cavity, plus an Integrated Pizza Plate with manual rotation and multi-stage cooking memory. The high-end Kitchen Pro series offers advanced features like Air Frying (PMO-26 KITCHEN PRO CAF) and Inverter technology combined with Air Frying (PMO-30 KITCHEN PRO ICAF).

chunks.title: What the Power Level / Tap Settings Mean
chunks.content_brief: The tap or power-level setting on a PEL convection microwave controls how much microwave power is used, or switches to a grill/convection combination. Tap 1 (P-100) is full 100% microwave power. Taps 2-10 step down in 10% increments (P-90 down to P-10), useful for gentler reheating or defrosting. Tap 11 (P-00) is essentially off/standby. Two combination settings blend microwave and grill: Tap 1 combination is 30% microwave / 70% grill, and Tap 2 combination is 55% microwave / 45% grill. For pure convection baking, temperature setpoints run from 110°C up to 200°C in 10° steps depending on the tap selected. There are also 4 pre-set hybrid combination programs at fixed temperatures: Program 1 (110°C), Program 2 (140°C), Program 3 (170°C), and Program 4 (200°C).

chunks.title: Microwave Error Codes — What They Mean & What You Can Do
chunks.content_brief: E01 means the oven cavity is reporting an unsafe high temperature — press Stop/Cancel and let the unit cool before using it again. E02 means the surrounding room temperature is reading too low for normal operation; this usually resolves once the room warms up, and if it doesn't, contact PEL support. E03 means there's a fault in the internal thermal safety circuit — stop using the unit and have a PEL technician inspect it before further use. It's normal for the cooling fan to keep running for about 3 minutes after any cook cycle longer than 2 minutes; that's not a fault.
chunks.content_detailed: E01: Cabin temp exceeds safe limits (Super High Temperature Alert). Field action: Press Stop/Cancel, verify sensor resistance parameters. E02: Ambient temp drops below tolerance (Super Low Temperature Alert). Field action: Cycle input power line. E03: Thermal processing circuit grounding short. Field action: Replace thermal NTC/PTC component block. Cooling Fan Rule: Runs 3 mins post-cycle if task > 2 mins continuously, to cool internal electronics.
